title: Generative Monoculture in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the reduction in output diversity by comparing the statistical dispersion (e.g., entropy, standard deviation, pairwise Jaccard similarity, and cosine similarity) of LLM-generated text and code against human-authored source datasets (Goodreads and CodeContests) across attributes like topics, word choice, and algorithmic techniques.

Generating book reviews for books with mixed reception using LLMs and extracting their sentiment using a fine-tuned classifier, then comparing the sentiment distribution against the original human-authored reviews to demonstrate a severe skew towards overwhelming positivity.
